stack-edge-billing-until-return.title: A trial or test Stack Edge device keeps billing until you start the return
stack-edge-billing-until-return.body: This is a non-production estimate for an Azure Stack Edge device, which is a recurring subscription rather than pay-per-use. Billing does not stop when you stop using the device; it stops when you initiate the return, so start the return as soon as the test ends and keep the one-off return and shipping fees in the budget.

citation.source: FAQ: Billing for Azure Stack Edge Pro GPU
citation.quote: Billing stops when you initiate return of the device.
